newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Carlsbad, N.M..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Carlsbad, N.M..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the CARLSBAD HOUSING
CORPORATION, a New Mexico non-profit corporation (the
Issuer'') created by and on behalf of the REGIONAL HOUSING AUTHORITY OF REGION VI NEW MEXICO (the
intends to issue, sell and deliver its Multifamily Housing Revenue Bonds (Colonial Hillcrest/La Posada Apartments
Projects) Series 1997, in an aggregate principal amount of $1,800,000 (the 1997 Bonds''), on
at the offices of Hinkle, Cox, Eaton, Coffield & Hensley, 218 Montezuma, Santa Fe, New Mexico 87501.

The Bonds are being issued for the purpose of (i) Repaying existing indebtedness of the Colonial Hillcrest/La Posada Apartments in the City of Carlsbad, New Mexico, (ii) Providing reimbursement for prior capital expenditures of the Colonial Hillcrest and La Posada Apartments, (iii) Financing the rehabilitation and renovation costs of the Colonial Hillcrest and La Posada Apartments, (iv) Satisfying the debt service reserve fund requirement for the 1997 Bonds, if any, and (v) Satisfying the costs of issuing the 1997 Bonds. In this connection, the Issuer has fixed the maximum aggregate principal amount of the 1997 Bonds, the maximum number of years over which the 1997 Bonds may mature, the maximum interest rate or rates which the 1997 Bonds may bear and the maximum discount from par, if any, at which the 1997 bonds may be sold; has approved forms of a final bond resolution, and an indenture of trust, and has provided for the publication of Notice of Bonds to be Issued, provided for the publication of Notice of Bond Sale; provided for the running of a contest period; and related matters.

The Bonds shall be dated as of their date of delivery to the original purchaser(s) thereof, shall mature in not more than thirty (30) years from their date or dates, shall bear interest at a rate or rates not to exceed nine percent (9%) per annum (calculated on the basis of a year of 360 days comprised of twelve 30-day months), and shall be sold at a price not less than par.
First Security Bank, N.A. shall serve as Trustee, Paying Agent and Registrar for the Bonds.
Inquiries with respect to the issuance and sale of the bonds may be directed to, and copies of the PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT pertaining to the Bonds may be obtained from:
REGIONAL HOUSING AUTHORITY OF REGION VI, NEW MEXICO, INC.
